B-normal-only.proxyDifference: Control adds area-weighted vertex NORMAL; source positions, indices and colors retained.
B-normal-only.limitation: normalMap also affects native cross-view incidence weighting; this is not solely a lighting ablation.
B-normal-only.normalRGBOnlyVerification: See separately recorded control invariant checks for normal alpha and registered RGB.

C.proxyDifference: Actual stage geometry changes are retained; no image-based shape alignment.
C.limitation: C retains B source/aligned RGB and mapping. Geometry changes can alter atlas alpha, newly exposed pixels and boundary fallback; colorMap byte identity is not required.

processing: Opaque backdrop for transparent PNGs, integer head crops enlarged 2x nearest-neighbor; full-body previews downsampled with Lanczos. No sharpening or AI postprocessing.
